notes.title: Polar Star, now stutter-free
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.3 brings Polar Star to Godot 4.4! [/h1]

This update focuses on improving performance of the game, especially getting rid of the [b]stutters[/b] caused by shader compilation. 

Also save file can [b]self-heal[/b] now: if a variable is missing from the file, the game will fill it up automatically, so nothing in your settings or save will break.

But the update has a new feature too: the death screen now shows your [b]personal best score[/b] in the custom endless mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602301/67d68ae71d08332c8c8b618431faa1e526a5dde4.png[/img]

The full game is actively being worked on, and the development is going pretty smoothly right now, so stay tuned for future updates. [b]This is not a goodbye, as our long conversation has only just begun...[/b]
